Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + controls evidence for procurement

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement requested our security review checklist so we can move Redwood through our procurement pipeline. We're specifically looking for:

- The most recent SOC 2 Type II report and your auditor (period covered).
- Any bridge letter or statement if the audit doesn't cover the last 6 months.
- Specific supporting evidence for controls called out in the SOC report: MFA enforcement logs, admin access reviews (last 3 cycles), authn/authz change logs, and logging/retention configuration for API request logs.

If you can provide the report and a short package that maps the controls to the specific artifacts (or point to where we can download), that will speed our security review. Procurement (cc'd) has a target to complete vendor security review by 3/15.

Appreciate it — let me know if we should sign an NDA or use a secure file transfer.

Jordan Mills
Senior Security Analyst
MediTech Health

Jordan — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to get this over to you. Quick plan:

- I'll attach the signed SOC 2 Type II report we published (2025 audit period) and a draft bridge letter we use when the audit doesn't cover the most recent months.
- Markus (security) will reply with the MFA enforcement evidence, details on retention for logs, and the last three access review summaries.
- Vivek (engineering) will attach a sanitized export of API request logging configuration and retention window.
- Monica (legal) will confirm whether we need any additional NDAs or a secure transfer method for the access export.

Our target is to deliver the package by EOD tomorrow (3/3). If procurement needs an accelerated timeline, say the specific controls you need first and we'll prioritize.

Marissa Cole

Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + controls evidence for procurement

Jordan / team — following up with the specifics you requested and a short explanation of coverage: 

1) Audit period / bridge letter: The attached SOC 2 Type II covers period 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30 and was performed by Crestpoint Audit LLP. Because our last audit ended 2025-06-30, we have a standard bridge letter template (attached: audit_bridge_letter_draft.docx) that documents any material changes to controls since the audit end date. If you require auditor-signed bridge letters, we can coordinate that with Crestpoint but will likely need a purchase order / SOW for that extra work.

2) MFA enforcement evidence:
- We enforce MFA for all interactive user accounts via SAML 2.0 with Okta.
- Attached: user_access_snapshot_2026-02-28.csv (sanitized export) — columns: username, role, last_auth_method, mfa_enforced (true/false), last_mfa_change.
- We can also provide an audit log extract showing MFA enforcement events for a scoped set of admin accounts if you need event-level proof.

3) Access reviews and admin recertification:
- Access review cadence: quarterly. Last three completed cycles: 2025-09, 2025-12, 2026-03 (recertification in progress; summary attached).
- Records include reviewer, affected roles, and remediation actions. We have redacted PII in the snapshots.

4) Logging & retention:
- API request logs are retained for 90 days in our centralized logging cluster; security-relevant events are archived for 540 days.
- We ship logs to a customer-segregated S3 bucket for Dedicated/Private customers upon request and support longer retention under contract.

Next steps: I've attached the SOC 2 report and the sanitized exports. Monica — please confirm if we should use the secure SharePoint link or request Meditech's SFTP details for the access export.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, user_access_snapshot_2026-02-28.csv, audit_bridge_letter_draft.docx

Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 14:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + controls evidence for procurement

Markus / Marissa — this is perfect, thanks. A couple quick clarifications before procurement closes this out: 

- Can you confirm whether MFA is enforced by policy for service accounts used by internal automation (we often see exceptions there)? If not, we'll ask for compensating controls.
- For the access-review summaries, can you provide the remediation counts (how many accounts were revoked or role-changed) for each of the last three cycles? A simple table is fine.
- If you can provide the auditor contact at Crestpoint (email) for the SOC 2 report validation, that would help.

Procurement is happy to accept the secure SharePoint link. If you can post the artifacts there and grant read access to alyssa@meditech.com and security@meditech.com, we'll confirm receipt and mark the vendor security check complete.

I'll stand by for the short clarifications and the SharePoint link.

Jordan Mills
Senior Security Analyst
MediTech Health
